messages:
lucy: Quick heads-up — aiming for a minimal hotpatch release (v1.12.8) to fix the kvcache timeout regression. Cutoff at 18:00 PT today. PRs to include: #4321 (kvcache backport), #4330 (smoke tweak). Need final LGTM + smoke run by 17:30 PT. Tagging @release-captain for rollout.
omar: Ack — I'll run local smoke and re-run the failing integration test. Expect results in ~15m.
chris: Re: changelog — keep it tiny: 'Fix: kvcache timeout under heavy load (regression)'. I'll open a changelog PR and add the internal [hotfix][kvcache] tag.
sylvia: Code review incoming from me. If CI is green I'll approve quickly.
release-captain: Reminder: strict minimal diffs only. No dependency bumps or non-essential changes. I'll lock the release branch at cutoff and gate merges.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-17 18:00 PT -> 18:30 PT. Canary + progressive rollout configured. Notifying on-call.
omar: Local smoke passed. Pushing backport PR now: https://git.redwood/PR/4321 (cherry-pick of commit 7f4a3b).
lucy: @chris when you update the changelog, include the concise internal note and CI label: `release:hotfix` so the infra bot picks it up.
chris: Done — changelog PR #4340 opened, small one-liner in CHANGELOG.md.
sylvia: CI caught a lint nit in kvcache patch, fixing in a follow-up commit.
lucy: Rollback procedure reminder: if canary shows regression, we rollback to tag `v1.12.7` and pause the queue. @omar will have permission to trigger rollback.
release-captain: Confirmed. I'll monitor the merge queue and freeze unrelated merges at 17:55 PT. No force merges without explicit approval.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 18:05 PT on 10% traffic. Health checks passing, latency within SLO. 
SIGHUP: monitor logs and pagers enabled. :thumbsup:
sylvia: Smoke on canary looks good, metrics stable, LGTM from me.
omar: Merged cherry-pick into `release/1.12.x`. Merge queue processed cleanly.
lucy: Thanks team — proceeding with rollout. I'll follow up with a brief postmortem note after the release and close the thread.
